turns.content:
I see the issue! The `aggregations.pyx` file has been modified to change `>=` to `>` in many places. This changes the logic for when calculations are performed - instead of computing when `nobs >= minp` (nobs is greater than or equal to minp), it now only computes when `nobs > minp` (nobs is strictly greater than minp). This would cause incorrect results because it skips the case where nobs equals minp.
